chunkInspection.textSnippet:
Document: Get-CsOnlineUser
Heading Path: Get-CsOnlineUser -> PARAMETERS -> -Filter

Applicable: Microsoft Teams

Enables you to limit the returned data by filtering on specific attributes. For example, you can limit returned data to users who have been assigned a specific voice policy, or users who have not been assigned a specific voice policy.

Document: Get-CsTeamsCallingPolicy

Teams calling policies help determine which users are able to use calling functionality within Microsoft Teams.
